svg.aria-label: Tabs dimensional architecture: segment, pill, underline, selected indicator layers and overflow

g.text: Scale 1.05:1 · md default · all widths schematic
Axonometric · z gaps schematic · labels stay above indicator
Segment / pill tracks hug; underline fills.
Panels stay mounted; hidden panels leave flow.
Base primitive owns selection and arrow keys.
Selected indicator measures actual tab bounds.
Vertical list stacks; panel flexes beside it.
Only hidden edges fade; scrolling reveals tabs.
WIDTHS AND CONTENT HEIGHTS ARE SCHEMATIC.
SM / MD TABLE VALUES FOLLOW ROOT 16PX.
DEFAULT: RAISED SURFACE CHIP ON MUTED TRACK
SOLID: BACKGROUND CHIP ON BORDER-TONE TRACK; NO SHADOW
OUTLINE: BORDERED TRACK + MUTED CHIP; UNDERLINE IGNORES APPEARANCE
Schematic · rows stretch across track; heights are content-led
S7 fades + blur F1 · horizontal x / vertical y · scrollbars hidden
Scale 3:1 · nominal blur envelope · default appearance
PANEL: OPACITY + Y 4 → 0, 150MS · REDUCED MOTION: JS 0 / CSS NONE
